operations.currentBehaviour: router.push of ?tab=<id>; unknown tab silently falls back to dashboard, so the `?? <Empty title="Not found"/>` at line 255 is dead code
operations.requiredBehaviour: Unknown tab returns a real 404/not-found state; nav reflects role-visible sections only
operations.validation: tab id in the known set

operations.currentBehaviour: Reads installed[] from localStorage; renders a marketplace Link. Any user can flip the array in devtools
operations.requiredBehaviour: Server-side entitlement check; API refuses POS endpoints without the entitlement

operations.currentBehaviour: Client reduce over posDocs. `posted` = invoices with status not Draft/Cancelled — but no code path ever changes status, so posted is ALWAYS empty and every KPI is 0.00
operations.requiredBehaviour: Server aggregate over posted invoices scoped by tenant/company/currency/date range

operations.currentBehaviour: setState only; filters client-side on ageOf(createdAt) <= days using Date.now()
operations.requiredBehaviour: Server-side date-range filter on an explicit issue date in the tenant time zone

operations.currentBehaviour: Counts per stage client-side; prints `USD {value}` as a RAW unformatted float (line 149) while every other figure uses money()
operations.requiredBehaviour: Server stage counts and sums with consistent money formatting and currency scoping

operations.currentBehaviour: Buckets posted invoices by getMonth() IGNORING THE YEAR, so a 2024 invoice lands in the 2025 bar; header claims CY and admits 'no fiscal year configured'
operations.requiredBehaviour: Bucket by fiscal period with an explicit year filter and a configured fiscal calendar

operations.currentBehaviour: Buckets on dueDate, which is always '' — age resolves to -1 so everything would fall in 'Current'; combined with posted=[] the panel is always empty
operations.requiredBehaviour: Age from a real dueDate derived from payment terms; buckets computed server-side as at a snapshot date

operations.currentBehaviour: HARDCODED: every band renders 'USD 0', '0 invoices' and a zero bar regardless of data
operations.requiredBehaviour: Real due-band aggregation (Overdue / Due today / 7d / 8-30d / later)

operations.currentBehaviour: Counts doc.payment === Paid|Part paid|Unpaid; payment is hardcoded 'Unpaid' at create and never updated, so Paid and Part paid are permanently 0
operations.requiredBehaviour: Derive payment state from allocations vs invoice total

operations.currentBehaviour: Groups open invoices by the customer NAME STRING into a Map, top 5. Two customers with the same name merge into one row
operations.requiredBehaviour: Group by customer_id; display name resolved at render

operations.currentBehaviour: 'Reports →' (169), 'Chase →' (204) and 'View all →' (230) are plain <span> elements styled as accent links — not focusable, no handler, no href
operations.requiredBehaviour: Real navigation to the reports / collections / AR aging surfaces, keyboard reachable

operations.currentBehaviour: Filters the whole in-memory posCustomers array; no pagination, no sort, no loading or error state
operations.requiredBehaviour: Paged, sorted, tenant-scoped server list with loading/error/empty states

operations.currentBehaviour: setState + client substring match over name+email+taxId, lowercased
operations.requiredBehaviour: Server search with trigram/FTS index, debounced

operations.currentBehaviour: setState only. Useless in practice: active is hardcoded true at every create path, so the inactive set is always empty
operations.requiredBehaviour: includeArchived query param backed by a real archive action

operations.currentBehaviour: addPosCustomer -> localStorage via useWorkspace; id = crypto.randomUUID(), active forced true, no duplicate check, no email validation, writes a pos.customer_created audit row whose resourceId is the NAME
operations.requiredBehaviour: Server create with validation, dedup suggestion, tenant scope, real actor in audit
operations.validation: name required/trimmed/<=200; email RFC + unique per tenant; taxId format per jurisdiction (UNDEFINED in source)

operations.currentBehaviour: Triggers a Blob download named customers.csv built by naive template join — NO quoting, NO escaping, NO formula guard. A name containing a comma corrupts the row; a name starting with '=' is a spreadsheet formula. The shared csvCell/downloadCsv helpers in src/lib/csv.ts are NOT used
operations.requiredBehaviour: Server export honouring the caller's permission and current filter, RFC4180 quoting, formula-safety prefix, correct MIME, audit row

operations.currentBehaviour: FileReader + split(/\r?\n/).slice(1) + row.split(','), ignoring the header names entirely and assuming column order name,email,taxId. Quoted commas break it. No size/MIME limit, no dedup, no error surface, no preview — each row is committed one-by-one and a mid-file failure leaves a partial import. parseCsv() in src/lib/csv.ts is NOT used
operations.requiredBehaviour: Staged upload, header mapping, per-row validation report, dedup, atomic commit, size/MIME limits
operations.validation: MIME text/csv, size cap, header mapping, per-row errors returned

operations.currentBehaviour: MISSING — rows are not clickable; there is no detail view and no edit control anywhere
operations.requiredBehaviour: Detail + edit with optimistic-concurrency version check

operations.currentBehaviour: MISSING — no delete or deactivate control exists despite the Inactive badge and the Show inactive filter
operations.requiredBehaviour: Archive (never hard delete) with a block when open documents reference the customer

operations.currentBehaviour: MISSING — the Customer groups pane promises segments 'chosen from a list on the customer record'; the customer form has only name/email/taxId
operations.requiredBehaviour: Group picker on the customer record; reports groupable by segment

operations.currentBehaviour: Client filter of posDocs on kind==='contract' plus a status equality check
operations.requiredBehaviour: Server list with paging and status/term filters

falseSuccessCopy.why: No scheduler, cron or job exists anywhere. Only the manual button exists, and it bills every Active subscription regardless of whether anything is due.

falseSuccessCopy.why: Specific double-entry postings promised on the till screen. No posting code, no unit cost field and no warehouse entity exist.

falseSuccessCopy.why: There is no sale capture and no tender model. cashTaken and cardTaken are written as 0 at shift open and never incremented, so every reconciliation figure is 0.

falseSuccessCopy.why: No interval, polling or subscription exists in the file. The dashboard only updates when React re-renders for another reason.

falseSuccessCopy.why: The panel renders a single aggregate number, never a daily series. There is no chart and no per-day breakdown.

falseSuccessCopy.text: Sorted by amount owed. Ordered oldest-first within each row.

falseSuccessCopy.why: Hardcoded literals in the JSX, not derived from data — the panel would still read zero with a full book of receivables.

falseSuccessCopy.why: The policy is saved and re-read but never evaluated; the Warn/Block/Ignore action and the Require-Order/Require-Delivery switches gate nothing.

falseSuccessCopy.text: Anything larger blocks the close until they pick a reason.
falseSuccessCopy.why: closePosShift accepts any counted figure with no reason prompt, no threshold check and no blocking. The field to store a reason does not exist.

falseSuccessCopy.text: Points accrue on the net subtotal of every sale attached to a customer, and are spent at the till as a discount on the bill.
falseSuccessCopy.why: There is no sale, no points balance, no ledger and no redemption path. The programme row stores only a rate and a point value.

falseSuccessCopy.text: Loyalty & tiers … plus the tier ladder customers climb on lifetime spend.
falseSuccessCopy.why: The tiers array is hardcoded to [] at create and there is no UI anywhere to add, view or edit a tier.

falseSuccessCopy.text: Items point at a category, so changing a rate is one edit here rather than an edit on every affected item.
falseSuccessCopy.why: No item or line-item entity exists in this domain, so nothing can point at a tax category — and the split is frozen into display strings at create time, so a rate cannot be edited at all.

falseSuccessCopy.text: Every change made here, with who made it and when — and how to undo it.
falseSuccessCopy.why: There is no undo control; the `reverted` flag is never set; before/after values are not stored; and the author is the hardcoded literal 'owner' rather than the signed-in user.

falseSuccessCopy.text: Describe what you want in plain English … Every change is saved in Change History and can be undone.
falseSuccessCopy.why: The button only opens the global Copilot dock, which spends 2 credits and returns a canned paragraph. It cannot change a single setting, and nothing can be undone.

falseSuccessCopy.text: Runs automatically on create
falseSuccessCopy.why: Printed under every agent row. No agent runs on create or at any other time; the catalogue entry ('Quote Quality Reviewer') has no execution path.

falseSuccessCopy.text: Pause AI agents (all apps) / 'Paused AI agents across all apps'
falseSuccessCopy.why: The flag is stored inside posSettings.agents, scoped to this app alone, so it cannot affect any other app even if agents ran.

falseSuccessCopy.text: Add extra data fields to capture information specific to your business.
falseSuccessCopy.why: No create or edit form in the domain renders custom fields, so a defined field can never hold a value — while the Appearance pane reports a count of them as if they were in use.

falseSuccessCopy.text: Till currency: USD — Org default
falseSuccessCopy.why: Presented as inherited configuration; it is a hardcoded literal. Company.currency exists in the workspace store and is never read.

falseSuccessCopy.text: Only posted, unpaid invoices appear here — a draft invoice is not yet a receivable.
falseSuccessCopy.why: Technically accurate but misleading as a reassurance: no invoice can ever be posted, so this pane is permanently empty by construction rather than because nothing is owed.

openQuestions: Subscription cadence: no interval, anchor, start or end field exists anywhere. What billing frequencies must be supported, what is the period key format, and does billing anchor to the subscription start or to a calendar boundary?

Subscription sweep scope: should 'Run due now' bill only periods whose due date has passed, and should a manual run be limited to one per tenant per business date? Source only filters on status === 'Active'.
Payment terms: dueDate is never populated. Are terms held on the customer, the contract, the invoice, or a tenant default — and are they net days, end-of-month, or a schedule?
Money semantics: is PosDoc.total tax-inclusive or tax-exclusive, and does it include or exclude discounts and shipping? No subtotal/tax/discount breakdown exists to disambiguate.

Currency policy: the till hardcodes USD labelled 'Org default' while Company.currency exists and is never read. Is the domain single-currency per company, and if not, what FX source and rate-snapshot point apply?

Rate contract semantics: the blurb promises an agreed rate, a committed volume and a term, none of which are captured. What defines precedence when a contract, a price list and a manual override disagree?
Quotation status semantics: who may move a quote to Sent/Accepted/Rejected, what triggers Expired (no validity date exists), and what distinguishes Superseded from Cancelled?
Quotation title: it is currently stored in the same `reason` column used for credit/return/refund reasons. Confirm these are two distinct concepts before the column is split.
Over-delivery: is shipping more than the ordered quantity allowed, blocked, or allowed within a tolerance? Nothing in source addresses it.
3-way match basis: are the price and quantity tolerances percentages of a line or of the document total, and are they evaluated at invoice creation, at posting, or both?
Return semantics: are returns raised per invoice line or at header level, and what caps a partial refund — invoiced quantity, invoiced value, or the remaining credit?
Credit note 'Applied': what can a credit be applied to (a specific invoice, the account balance, a future invoice), and is partial application allowed?
Refund execution: 'Sent' and 'Failed' imply an outbound payment path. No provider, method or contract is named anywhere in source — this needs an explicit product decision and must not be inferred.
Cash variance 'recent average': the policy stores amberAverage/redAverage but no code computes an average and no window length is defined. Over how many shifts or days?
Variance reason: the settings hint promises a blocking reason prompt above a threshold. Is the reason free text or a controlled taxonomy, and who may override the block?
Cashier identity: shifts store session.user.fullName as a string, defaulting to the literal 'Cashier'. Should a cashier be a platform user, an HR employee record, or a POS-specific operator?
Terminal / till identity: there is no terminal entity, so nothing prevents two concurrent open shifts. Is a shift per terminal, per cashier, or per store?
Warehouse source: the till offers two hardcoded warehouse names. Should these come from the Inventory app, and is the POS-to-inventory posting in scope at all?

Tax model: the seeded slabs render CGST/SGST/IGST strings and the within-state vs inter-state choice depends on buyer and seller registration, neither of which is captured. The statutory rules, the jurisdiction determination and the applicable rates must be supplied as an explicit decision — they must not be inferred from the seed array or from marketing copy.
Tax rate changes: must posted documents retain the rate in force at posting (rate snapshot), and do tax categories need effective-from/to dating?

Loyalty accrual: 'net subtotal' is undefined (before or after discount, before or after tax), the rounding rule for fractional points is unspecified, points have no expiry rule, and no currency is attached to pointValue.
Loyalty tiers: what window defines 'lifetime spend', in which currency, and do tiers ever downgrade?
Customer groups: the pane exists with no linkage. Is a customer in exactly one group, and does the group drive pricing, tax or only reporting?

Report definitions: cohort granularity and retention window, the margin cost basis (there is no unit cost anywhere), the Z-report boundary (business date vs shift), and the cashflow forecast method are all undefined in source.

Fiscal calendar: the dashboard states 'no fiscal year configured, assuming calendar year'. What is the fiscal year start, and does the monthly chart need a year filter (today it buckets by month across all years)?

Role model: this domain has no roles at all — every audit row is hardcoded to user 'owner' / role 'Org_admin'. The POS role catalogue (cashier, shift manager, sales editor, AR/finance approver) and the separation-of-duties rules for credit notes and refunds need to be defined.
Company scoping: Company and IntercompanyPair exist in the workspace store but no POS record references a company. Are sales documents, tills and settings scoped per legal entity?

Document deletion: every list offers an unconfirmed hard delete, including of invoices, credit notes and refunds. Which documents may ever be deleted rather than voided, and does deletion need to preserve the reference number?
Custom fields: which records should carry them (customer, each document kind, shift), and should dropdown options be captured at definition time?
Settings undo: the Change History promises undo but stores no before/after values. Which settings changes must be reversible, and what happens when a later change conflicts with the reverted one?

AI agents: the 'Quote Quality Reviewer' has no model, prompt, credit cost or output contract in source. What does it emit, where is it surfaced, and what does the auto-pause credit threshold actually gate?
